card.fact_statement: The Constitutional Democratic Party formulated plans to hold opposition primaries.
card.source_span: the Constitutional Democratic Party (CDP) and Ishin no Kai Party in particular formulated plans to hold "opposition primaries"

target_qa_variants.question: ¿Qué partido político formuló planes junto al Partido Ishin no Kai para celebrar primarias de la oposición?
target_qa_variants.source_span: the Constitutional Democratic Party (CDP) and Ishin no Kai Party in particular formulated plans to hold "opposition primaries"
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'Constitutional Democratic Party' to its established Spanish name 'Partido Democrático Constitucional'. The acronym 'CDP' was translated to its Spanish equivalent 'PDC', while also retaining 'CDP' as it is commonly used internationally.

backtranslation_en.question: Which political party formulated plans together with the Ishin no Kai Party to hold opposition primaries?

backtranslation_consistency.reason: The target language QA accurately translates the source question and expected answer without altering the core fact or introducing new constraints.
